Academic foundation · Primary references

Research foundations for customer, market and competitive intelligence

These primary works support research design, marketing mix, competitive analysis and value creation. They do not validate a particular market estimate, nor change the protected KAI·ROI v1 equations.

W. R. Smith (1956) · Market SegmentationMarket segmentation and differentiated marketing: define the audience before sizing or projecting sales.Open reference ↗McCarthy (1960) · Basic MarketingFour Ps framework: Product, Price, Place and Promotion, applied to customer needs and competitor evidence.Open reference ↗Osterwalder et al. (2014) · Value Proposition DesignConnect customer jobs, pains and gains to products, benefits and relevant value propositions.Open reference ↗Porter (1980) · Competitive StrategyIndustry rivalry, competitive advantage, substitutes and market positioning.Open reference ↗ESOMAR / ICC · International CodeEthical market research, respondent transparency, evidence quality and responsible use of research.Open reference ↗OECD · SME and productivity evidenceUse appropriate, comparable economic measures and retain the assumptions behind strategic decisions.Open reference ↗

METHODOLOGY AT THE END OF THE JOURNEY

DIIIP connects evidence to executive decisions

Strategy Research turns authorised upstream sources, customer insight and market observations into qualified recommendations for the next C-Level owners.

D
Data

PMO BusinessContext and Lead User, Reputational SWOT, Affairs & Risk, and traceable market and competitor observations.

I
Information

Organised Buyer Persona, empathy and purchase drivers, four marketing policies, media, sources, price and audience definitions.

I
Intelligence

Guided customer research, competitive comparisons, SWOT classification, priority by impact and complexity, and traceable CAME actions.

I
Insights

Visual SWOT and priority matrices, comparable market benchmarks, conditional POSD effort and commercial consequences with UNKNOWN values preserved.

P
C-Level Destiny

Four separate draft contracts to Corporate Communication / UX, Business Development & Innovation, Strategy Planning and CMO.

KAI·ROI EQUATION · CUSTOMER EQUITY

Strategy Research provides governed evidence for KAI·ROI

Customer, competitive, market, SWOT and CAME evidence can inform later strategic decisions. This laboratory does not calculate KAI·ROI or approve financial scenarios.
